caption: The drawing depicts a full-length Victorian-era dress in a muted brownish-mauve color, accented with details in cream and dark purple. The bodice features long sleeves with pleated cuffs, lace at the wrists, a high lace-trimmed collar, and a central row of buttons from the neck to the waist. Decorative scalloped and zigzag trims accentuate the edges of the bodice and the overskirt, and chevron-shaped panels in the same purple color are set on the hips and skirt. The skirt is composed of several layers and flounces, including wide dark purple fringed bands, cream-colored ribbons, and four large bows distributed between the hip and the lower skirt. The lower skirt and hem are bordered by a scalloped edge, and there is a prominent gathered train at the back, shown in brown. To the right of the main colored illustration, there is a light grey pencil sketch of the dress from the rear, showing the structure of the bodice, the position of the bows and fringes, and the arrangement of ruffles at the skirt’s back. The background is plain beige paper, and there is a small stamp-like red mark near the bottom right corner. The name "Syrena Juvanís" is written in small letters at the lower right.
title: Dress
